//profiles.development: Dev client only. It is the ONLY profile whose EXPO_PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN is cleartext, and the ONLY one for which plugins/with-api-origin-pinning relaxes ATS and the Android network security config — and it relaxes them for hard-coded loopback hosts, not for whatever origin is configured. There is no runtime server-URL switch in this app.
//profiles.preview: Internal distribution (TestFlight / internal APK). Same native posture as production: HTTPS only, cleartext refused. This is the profile that must reproduce a production streaming session, because a simulator on the development profile can hide an ATS mistake.
//profiles.production: Store distribution. `appVersionSource: remote` plus `autoIncrement` keeps the build number off the working tree, so two people cannot ship the same buildNumber from two branches.
//profiles.no-secrets-here: Every `env` value above is inlined into the JS bundle by babel-preset-expo and is readable by anyone who downloads the app. Nothing that is not already public may appear in these blocks — no provider credential, no internal HMAC key, no FastAPI hostname. Secrets that a BUILD genuinely needs (store credentials) live in EAS secrets, never in this file.
//profiles.channels-vs-updates: The `channel` keys are declared so an OTA channel exists the day code signing does. `updates.enabled` is false in app.config.ts until the certificate is embedded and the private key lives outside this repo; see the comment block there.
